ev.q: In 2005, two cases of melioidosis (one in August, one in October) were reported
A total of nine laboratorians (six from the Broward County hospital and three from the Miami-Dade County hospital) had high-risk exposures
None of the nine exposed laboratorians reported symptoms consistent with melioidosis.
all were negative for presence of B. pseudomallei
This report summarizes the clinical and laboratory aspects of the cases
